The '''Mirrsteel Grande Opera House''' was an [[Opera/Legends|opera]] house located in [[Mirrsteel Heights]], a collection of towers in the [[Kwenn Space Station/Legends|Kwenn Space Station]]. It was known for performing ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]''.<ref name="LoNH" />
